Deploy and activate ESET security products After setting up your cloud-based or on-premises management console, you can proceed with creating installers of ESET security products and deploying them across your endpoints and servers. Please refer to your activation email for setup instructions and a comprehensive list of products available with your subscription. If you have lost your activation email, use the Lost subscription form to have it resent. Find the modules you would like to deploy All modules are OS specific (Windows, macOS, Android, etc.).
